The guide gives no accessibility guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

misreads-source: The gold-holding example has no onPress. The guide says "A card without onPress is disabled too". The evidence's Limits say not to imply "that a card without onPress works", and its Hosting gives every card onPress. So this example renders as a disabled button, which the guide's Gold holding example is not.

lost-context: The Disabled state says it comes only from `disabled`. The guide also says "A card without onPress is disabled too, and then its footer links and button don't respond to clicks either", which is the condition most likely to catch an agent out.

The guide and its evidence were checked on 21 October on 0.1.78-c7d3348 and not re-checked on the installed build, dbe0e02, which changed HoldingsCard for #362 (a white card and a dark badge by default, a gold Apply that takes the card's modes, purple links, a working footer without onPress, a width that fills a stretching host up to 328). This entry follows the installed package and leaves out the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts (listed in its notes). Re-extract once #362 is fixed and the guide is re-checked and published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch2, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Choosing a loan offer: a Title over two offer cards, each 328 px wide. The screen holds the choice: selected is true only on the offer it holds, and each card's onPress should pick that offer (the handlers here are stubs).
examples.jsx:
<VStack style={{ width: 328 }}>
  <Title title="Pick an offer" subtitle="Pre-approved for you" />
  <HoldingsCard
    headerImage={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
    heroLabel="Loan amount up to"
    heroValue="₹1,89,000"
    details={[
      { label: 'Interest', value: '12% p.a.' },
      { label: 'Tenure', value: '36 months' },
      { label: 'Processing fee', value: '₹499' },
      { label: 'APR', value: '15.47%' },
      { label: 'EMI', value: '₹6,277/m' },
    ]}
    selected
    onPress={() => {}}
    style={{ width: 328 }}
  />
  <HoldingsCard
    headerImage={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
    heroLabel="Loan amount up to"
    heroValue="₹2,50,000"
    details={[
      { label: 'Interest', value: '13.5% p.a.' },
      { label: 'Tenure', value: '48 months' },
      { label: 'Processing fee', value: '₹999' },
      { label: 'APR', value: '16.2%' },
      { label: 'EMI', value: '₹6,768/m' },
    ]}
    selected={false}
    onPress={() => {}}
    style={{ width: 328 }}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: The screen lists its offers and keeps one selected: each card’s onPress picks that offer, and its selected follows the screen’s choice.

props.name: headerImage
props.description: None ships. Shown with contain, at the left, in a 100 × 23.69 box; an empty box of that size stays when it's left out. Declared: Source for the header image (e.g. bank logo).

props.name: heroLabel
props.description: 12 px on a 16 px line, over heroValue; it wraps. Declared: Label text above the hero value (e.g. "Loan amount up-to"). Default "Loan amount up-to", from the component source.

props.name: heroValue
props.description: 20 px bold on a 24 px line, under heroLabel; it wraps. Declared: Main hero value string (e.g. "₹1,89,000"). Default "₹1,89,000", from the component source.

props.name: details
props.description: Left out, the card shows five sample terms. Three to a row in equal columns, 12 px apart, with rows 16 px apart; a short row is padded. Declared: Array of detail items displayed in a 3-column grid below the hero.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the terms grid and gets the card's modes; the hero and the top right stay. Declared: Figma Slot — replaces the default details grid when provided. Additive; existing `details` callers are unchanged.

props.name: radio
props.description: false hides the whole top right: the Radio, a badgeLabel Badge, and a trailing component. Declared: Figma "Radio" boolean — shows/hides the header trailing. Defaults to `true` (same as the historical always-visible Radio). Default true, from the component source.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Figma Trailing instance-swap. When omitted, the legacy default `Radio` is rendered (wired to `selected` / `disabled`). Pass any node to override, or set `badgeLabel` to opt into the Figma Badge trailing.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description: Opt into the Figma Badge trailing instead of the legacy Radio. Ignored when `trailing` is set. Omit to keep Radio (back-compat).

props.name: footer
props.description: Figma Footer boolean. When `true`, renders the footer (divider + default action row, or `footerSlot` when provided). Defaults to `false` so existing layouts are unchanged. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: footerSlot
props.description: Replaces the footer body below the divider. Declared: Full override for the footer body below the divider. Only rendered when `footer` is `true`.

props.name: footerItems
props.description: Each item is a label over a Coin Link. Left out, the footer shows two placeholder links labelled “Link”. Declared: Default footer link columns (label + link). Ignored when `footerSlot` is set.

props.name: footerActionLabel
props.description: Label for the default footer action Button. Default "Apply", from the component source.

props.name: onFooterActionPress
props.description: Press handler for the default footer action Button.

props.name: selected
props.description: The card never changes selected itself: the screen sets it in onPress. Declared: Whether the radio button is selected (legacy default trailing). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the card / radio is disabled. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The card fades to 0.75 opacity while pressed. Declared: Called when the card is pressed. The card does not toggle `selected` itself — the caller updates `selected`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Optional accessible name for the card root.

props.name: modes
props.description: The Radio and the footer's Divider take the card's modes. Declared: Modes object for design-token resolution.

props.name: style
props.description: Applied last, after the card's own styles. Declared: Custom style for the outer container.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test ID for testing.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Term labels (10 px) wrap; term values (12 px) end in an ellipsis unless disableTruncation lets them wrap. Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

The card's radius (16), 1 px stroke, padding (20 / 16) and gap (10) don't change with any mode. Declared: A token collection HoldingsCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: At 328 px wide the card is about 7 px taller than Figma's (207.69 against 201): its hero line is 44 px against 42, its term rows 31 against 30, plus the border.
The package's default top right is a Radio, where Figma's Holdings Card defaults to a Badge (reported in #362).
